newsitem.title: USA: Pharmos acting CFO to leave company.
newsitem.headline: Pharmos acting CFO to leave company.

text.p: Pharmos Corp said on Wednesday that Alan Mark, who has been the company's acting chief financial officer and a financial consultant during the past year, was leaving to pursue other business opportunities.

The biopharmaceutical company said that while it searched for a new CFO, vice president/finance and controller Shaun Marcus would oversee accounting and financial reporting functions and act as corporate treasurer and controller.
Haim Aviv, chairman and Gad Riesenfeld, president, would be responsible for corporate finance and investor relations, Pharmos said.
Pharmos design, develops and commercializes proprietary products to treat opthalmic and neurologic disorders.
